gitCommit.subject: Public website: TSX-MR is operated by an individual, said truthfully in EN/FR/AR
gitCommit.body:
Public website: TSX-MR is operated by an individual, said truthfully in EN/FR/AR

TSX-MR is a project and trading name, not an incorporated company: it is
operated by Abdel Kerim Taleb Ould Sidi, a natural person. The site now
says so, and the production guard no longer asks for a legal form or an
RCCM that do not exist.

- schema: VITE_OPERATOR_TYPE (individual by default, or company). For an
  individual, the PUBLIC_WEBSITE gate refuses a legal form or RCCM rather
  than requiring one. The owner's facts are fallbacks (operator, person
  responsible for publication, Nouakchott, contact@, support@, privacy@,
  security@tsxmr.com). The correspondence address and effective date stay
  blank until given. The PORTAL rule is unchanged.
- Public telephone numbers: VITE_ORGANIZATION_PHONE, a comma-separated
  list, env-only (never hardcoded), shown as tel links and never labelled
  WhatsApp.
- One {operatorStatus} sentence per language. It is used by the legal
  notice, privacy, terms, about and footer, and avoids gendered wording.
- The legal notice names the person responsible for publication. An
  individual's details show no legal form or RCCM rows.
- Structured data: an individual's Organization carries no legalName,
  and the WebSite publisher is a Person.
- RTL: the Arabic operator sentence takes the paragraph's direction, and
  phone numbers are isolated left to right.
- The pre-launch legal drafts are now version 0.2 (still DRAFT).

Tests: 423 Vitest, plus an end-to-end identity check in EN/FR/AR.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01WqJ1WH6TJWfctbXGjyqFZt
